schema: FMZ 2170 · Legacy ticker binding and independent neural order verifier

notes.scope: The source's saved three-hour BTC perpetual dates and independent ETH comparison use complete official 15-minute bars. Three days of separate warmup supply prior daily and hourly observations. Historical calculations run on completed chart bars; live tick recalculation was outside the comparison.
notes.compatibility: The archive declares v2 but spells the four ticker IDs with the v4 namespace. Replacing only the symbol spelling with legacy tickerid keeps the original version and default alignment. Daily inputs are the previous two completed UTC days. Hourly inputs are the two hours preceding the first intrabar of each three-hour group.
notes.verification: Independent arithmetic decodes every archived coefficient, verifies three weighted tanh layers against the emitted predictions, then checks both exact authored thresholds, broker flags, state transitions and prices from the first 15-minute child of each market fill. The original lookahead warnings are documented, and the verified [1] and [2] inputs are already known.
notes.costs: One base unit and default 1,000,000 USDT capital per market. Gross uses source zero commission. Net subtracts a separately applied 0.075% per-side fee overlay. Workbook drawdown uses settled events. No forced terminal close.

coverage: Tested · Legacy neural predictions and causal price inputs
Only fixed the documented same-symbol ticker spelling for Pine v2. Independently verified daily/hourly prior inputs, all neural scores, both exit conditions, market fill prices and fee arithmetic.
